import sys

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    T = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        B = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr+N]))
        ptr += N

        possible = True
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(i+1, N):
                g = math.gcd(B[i], B[j])
                if B[i] != B[j] and g != B[i] and g != B[j]:
                    possible = False
                    break
            if not possible:
                break
        print("YES" if possible else "NO")

solve()
